look_here_first: Start with the foliage and bud shape. Berlandier's sundrops has very narrow linear leaves, a low spreading perennial/subshrub habit, bright yellow 4-petaled flowers, and distinctly 4-angled/square flower buds.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Hays — Natural Purola flora records the old synonym Calylophus berlandieri subsp. pinifolius. Travis — UT herbarium index records Calylophus berlandieri var. pinifolius. Williamson — dedicated treatment documents Oenothera capillifolia subsp. capillifolia. Current Kew places these Calylophus concepts under O. capillifolia.
project_inclusion.range_guardrail: Exact county evidence; reconciled historical synonyms only.

best_field_traits: flowers generally diurnal compared with classic evening primroses
morphology_keys.comparison_training: O. laciniata has much broader cut-lobed leaves. O. capillifolia is the fine-leaved yellow sundrop concept historically called Calylophus.
